items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: Brookhoven and that fellow used to have that job. William J. Braun, Brookhoven.

ctx.x: The funerals. Did you ever play on this side of the river?
Playing funerals? For funerals? No. Brookhoven and that fellow used to have that job. William J. Braun, Brookhoven.
They played on this side. You were on the other side then?
